capabilities: Browse folders, tags and properties in a dual-pane sidebar
Preview notes with thumbnails and metadata
Search and filter notes by name, tag, property, date and task
Create, move, merge and tag files
Open daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes from a calendar
extras: Optional network requests for update checks, icon packs, external images and language packs; startup debug logging can write a diagnostic file in the vault root.
intentEvidence: Turn Obsidian into a fast, customizable notes browser with folders, tags, properties and shortcuts in one view.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer keeps folders, tags and properties in separate views, which makes browsing and organizing large vaults slow.

relations.evidence: Install Style Settings (optional) - For customizing colors and appearance

summary: File browser and calendar that combines folders, tags, properties, shortcuts, previews and keyboard navigation in one sidebar view.
